headline: Paxos Gold Smart Contract Vulnerability Surface Analysis Shows Low On-Chain Risk
summary: A new report details the security of Paxos Gold (PAXG) on the Ethereum blockchain, revealing low on-chain risks but moderate-to-high off-chain operational concerns.
details: A recent analysis of the Paxos Gold (PAXG) token's smart contract vulnerability surface has been published, focusing on its implementation on the Ethereum Mainnet and other chains like Arbitrum and Optimism.

The report highlights that while the on-chain smart contract risks for PAXG are assessed as low (3.2/10), the off-chain and operational risks, including custody and redemption, are considered moderate to high.

Paxos Gold is a unique asset in the DeFi space, representing physical gold bullion held by Paxos Trust Company. Its value is directly tied to these off-chain assets and regulatory compliance, differentiating it from purely digital or algorithmic tokens.

The analysis specifically distinguishes between risks inherent in smart contract code execution and logic errors, versus those stemming from the physical custody and legal frameworks governing the asset.

headline_marked: [[Samsung Odyssey G55C]] curved gaming monitor drops to $199 at Amazon
headline: Samsung Odyssey G55C curved gaming monitor drops to $199 at Amazon
summary: Get a 32-inch, 1440p, 165Hz gaming monitor for $130 off its usual price. This limited-time deal makes high-end gaming visuals more accessible.
details: Amazon is offering a significant discount on the Samsung Odyssey G55C, a 32-inch curved gaming monitor. For a limited time, you can snag this display for just $199.99, a 39% price reduction from its original $329.99 MSRP, saving you $130.

The Odyssey G55C boasts a 1000R curvature for enhanced immersion, QHD 1440p resolution, and a rapid 165 Hz refresh rate. Combined with a 1 ms response time and AMD FreeSync support, it ensures smooth, tear-free gameplay essential for competitive gaming.

This monitor features HDR10 compliance for vibrant visuals and an Eye Saver Mode to reduce eye strain during long gaming sessions. Connectivity options include HDMI and DisplayPort, with a 3.5mm headphone jack for audio output, helping to minimize desk clutter.

While Samsung does not disclose specific DCI-P3 coverage or color accuracy, and its peak brightness is limited to 300 nits, the G55C remains a compelling option for gamers prioritizing speed and immersion over professional color grading. It also supports VESA mounting for greater flexibility.
